text: The UN Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on Myanmar (2019) found that any foreign business activity involving the Myanmar military and its conglomerates MEHL and MEC poses a high risk of contributing to, or being linked to, violations of international human rights and humanitarian law, and that at a minimum these foreign companies contribute to supporting the military's financial capacity. source.quote: Some joint ventures between foreign companies and Tatmadaw conglomerates are transparent, such as the 70 per cent stake of Posco Steel Co., Ltd., a South Korean steel company, in Myanmar Posco Steel Company Ltd., a MEHL company.
source.note: Paragraph 143. Paragraph 145 (legal and policy findings): 'The Mission finds that any foreign business activity involving the Tatmadaw and its conglomerates MEHL and MEC poses a high risk of contributing to, or being linked to, violations of human rights law and international humanitarian law. At a minimum, these foreign companies are contributing to supporting the Tatmadaw’s financial capacity.' Its annex of joint ventures lists 'Myanmar Posco C&C Company Ltd MEHL 70% by Posco Coated and Color Steel Co, Ltd.' and 'Myanmar Posco Steel Company Ltd MEHL 70% by Posco Steel Co. Ltd.'
